name: Strago and Relm
oracle_text: Sketch and Lore — {2}{R}, {T}: Target opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile an instant, sorcery, or creature card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. If you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste and "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this creature." Activate only as a sorcery.
blocked_sentences: Sketch and Lore — {2}{R}, {T}: Target opponent exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile an instant, sorcery, or creature card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. If you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste and "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this creature." Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.what: a `player` key on `exile_until` (e.g. {"target": "t1"} for a target opponent) so the walk exiles from the top of THAT player's library while the free-cast offer (`cast_free`) still goes to the ability's controller, who casts the opponent's card
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `op_exile_until` in engine/effects/ops_cards.py hardcodes `pid = ctx.controller` and walks only `ctx.state.players[pid].library`; it takes no `player`. `reveal_until` takes `player` and `playable_free`, but it leaves the walked-past cards in the library (bottom/shuffle) rather than exiled, and grants a later play permission instead of an immediate cast; `cascade` is controller-only with a mana-value ceiling and bottoms the rest

needs.what: a rider on a free cast made by an effect (`exile_until` cast_free, or `_offer_free_cast` generally): if the spell cast is a creature spell, the permanent it becomes gains haste and the granted triggered ability "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this creature." -- applied to the resulting permanent (not the spell), only when the card was actually cast this way
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cast_gains_keywords` is the only keyword rider on a cast spell and the loader refuses it outside the `cast_from_library_top` static; `exile_until` exposes no `as`-bound result telling whether the hit was cast (its `as` binds the hit cast or not), so a following `grant_keyword` + `grant_ability` would wrongly apply to an uncast card left in exile or to a spell still on the stack before it becomes a permanent; `cast_for_free`'s `haste` flag is suspend's internal and not reachable from the DSL, and it carries no end-step sacrifice
